name: TVS / ESD protection
description: Clamps transients to protect downstream circuitry. TVS for energy transients; ESD diodes for fast low-energy events.
topology: TVS diode or ESD diode array
expected_signal_behavior: Clamps at the breakdown voltage; low leakage below the working voltage.

common_failure_modes.description: diode shorted (failed short after a transient)

recommended_next_tests: check for short across the diode
